newsitem.title: CHINA: China EB Tech takes stake in Chevalier OA.
newsitem.headline: China EB Tech takes stake in Chevalier OA.

text.p: China Everbright Technology Ltd will take a 10 percent stake in Chevalier OA International Ltd, the companies said on Monday.

In a placement of old and new shares, parent company Chevalier International Holdings Ltd said it would place 82.78 million existing shares at HK$0.658 in Chevalier OA International Ltd to Everbright Technology, in a statement issued by all three companies.
The parent company would then subscribe for 135.63 million new shares, it said. Everbright will spend a total of HK$54.47 million to acquire the stake.
Trading in the shares of Chevalier International Holdings, and Chevalier OA and Everbright Technology, which was suspended on Wednesday, resumed on Monday morning.

The announcement arose out of discussions held by the company beginning on July 30 and followed two announcements issued earlier in July denying that the companies were in negotiations with Everbright Technology, the statement said.
In the statement, the companies reiterated their claim that no discussions had taken place before July 30.
The placing shares represent 10 percent of the enlarged issued share capital of the Chevalier OA following the issue of the new shares, it said.
The placement price represents a discount of 23.49 percent to the average closing price of HK$0.86 of Chevalier OA for the five trading days prior to its suspension, the statement said.

Everbright Technology will pay for the stake with the issue of 12.92 million new shares at HK$2.108, which will cover 50 percent of the cost of the acquisition with the remainder to be paid in cash from internal resources, the statement said.
The shares will represent about 1.09 percent of the issued share capital of Everbright Technology, it said.
Chevalier said it will use the proceeds from the sale of shares to increase general working capital, it said.
In June, Everbright Technology issued new shares to acquire Goodnice International Ltd, a computer keyboard maker.

Everbright said it believed it could achieve synergy effects by co-operating with Chevalier OA, which has a successful record in the supply, installation and servicing of computer equipment, office equipment and telecommunications systems.
Everbright Technology was HK$0.30 higher at HK$3.10 in early Monday trade, Chevalier OA jumped HK$0.53 to HK$1.54 and Chevalier International was up HK$0.05 at HK$2.675.
